posts.name: Barack Obama
posts.text:
Ahead of the holiday, Michelle and I got a chance to pack some boxes of food for families in need with the team at Dion’s Chicago Dream. 

Wishing everyone celebrating tomorrow a wonderful Thanksgiving!
posts.text_ko:
휴가를 앞두고 Michelle과 저는 Dion’s Chicago Dream 팀과 함께 도움이 필요한 가족들을 위해 음식 몇 상자를 포장할 기회를 얻었습니다. 

내일을 축하하는 모든 사람들이 멋진 추수감사절을 보내길 바랍니다!

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Fake News CNN was hoping for a bad outcome in Iowa. Their pre-coverage was inaccurate and deplorable. When a PERFECT detonation was completed and there for all to see, they went CRAZY with anger. They want our Country to lose. “Another win for Trump!”

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Rob Sands, the new future Governor of Iowa, is obviously unhappy that the Obama created (2009!) mess was so perfectly handled by the U.S. Army through a flawless detonation, that he’s now complaining about the lead up to the event. posts.text: Great job by the Army, and others, in Iowa!!! President DJT

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Stocks are down sharply because of the November Third Election results. I wasn’t on the Ballot, but if I was, the results, just like all three times before, would have been much different, and the Stock Market, and your 401-k’s, would be BOOMING. I told you so!!! President DJT

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Early reports from Iowa are that the Army’s mitigation efforts have far exceeded expectations.

posts.name: Stephen King
posts.text: Democrats and independents (many Republicans as well) are alarmed at DJT's relentless efforts to expand executive power. They are trying to put on the brakes. Based on Huang, it may not work. Certainly it's going to be tough.
posts.text_ko: 민주당과 무소속 의원들(많은 공화당 의원들도 포함)은 행정권을 확대하려는 DJT의 끊임없는 노력에 경악하고 있습니다. 그들은 브레이크를 걸려고 노력하고 있습니다. Huang에 따르면 작동하지 않을 수 있습니다. 확실히 힘들 것입니다.

posts.name: Barack Obama
posts.text: I couldn’t be prouder of all the candidates who stepped up this cycle to tell a better story about what our country can be. And I know they’re ready to deliver for the American people.
posts.text_ko: 저는 우리나라가 어떻게 될 수 있는지에 대해 더 나은 이야기를 전하기 위해 이번 주기를 밟은 모든 후보자들을 매우 자랑스럽게 생각합니다. 그리고 나는 그들이 미국 국민을 위해 전달할 준비가 되어 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다.

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Children in Baltimore are being removed from their homes without due process, parents allege, disproportionately affecting poor and Black families.

It’s a pattern seen nationally.
posts.text_ko:

전국적으로 볼 수 있는 패턴이다.

posts.name: The Associated Press
posts.text: Major League Baseball has sued its players' association in federal court, asking that its contemplated lockout next week be declared legal and trying to head off any attempt for the union to decertify and challenge the work stoppage with an antitrust case.
posts.text_ko: 메이저리그 사무국(MLB)은 선수협회를 연방법원에 고소해 다음 주에 예정된 직장 폐쇄를 합법화할 것을 요구하고 노조가 업무 중단에 대한 인증을 취소하고 독점금지 소송으로 이의를 제기하려는 시도를 막으려고 노력하고 있다.
